[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Computer (@AskPerplexity); megjelent: 2026-10-31T15:30:20+00:00; link: https://x.com/AskPerplexity/status/2116553363840241824; média: videó, 74 másodperc]
Computer built Pathways, a corridor tiled floor to ceiling with 821 images across 40 subjects from open collections including NASA and the Met.

Click any moving tile to read what it is, who made it and when, with a link to its source record.

Try it: https://pathways.pplx.app/
